title: Qonclave command
description: An instruction from a hub to an edge node. COMMUNICATION.md §4. Delivered by MQTT publish to qonclave/commands/<node_id> for always-on devices, or drained from the hub mailbox in a check-in response for duty-cycled ones.

action.description: Application-defined action name. The framework routes it; the device interprets it.

expires_at.description: After this instant the command MUST NOT be delivered or executed. This is what makes a mailbox safe for a device that sleeps for a day: a stale 'unlock the door' must expire rather than fire on wake.
